note: Passengers in the Hack activity. Some lines hint at the next story beat.

lines.text: Twenty-Third and Eighth. And hurry, I'm late for my own birthday.
Herald Square, please! Is that far? Is everything far?
My brother-in-law says somebody's buying all the hotels on Broadway.
Heard the fur vaults on Thirtieth lose power when it's hot. Imagine the bill.
Driver, you know the Deuce? Course you do. Everybody knows the Deuce.
I'm a nurse at Bellevue. Twelve hours. Don't talk, just drive. Please.
Wrong way! Seventh goes down, everybody knows that!
You going around the block to run the meter? I'm from here!
Good driver. You took Sixth. Smart. Here's a quarter extra.
There's a lawyer eats at the same counter every day at twelve-forty. Like a clock.
Oh thank God, a cab. In the rain! A miracle!
City's broke, they say. My cab fare's not broke.
Brownout last night. My building looked like a tomb.
My cousin works the Pennsylvania. Says there's a convention of morticians.
Keep the change. Buy yourself an air-conditioner.
